summary: Record lookup changed from employee NAME to employee ID
old_code: let record = data.find(r => r.employee === employeeName && r.date === today);
new_code: let record = data.find(r => r.employeeId === employeeId && r.date === today);
invariant: Must locate the correct record for the current employee on the current day. Name-based lookup was vulnerable to name duplicates; ID-based lookup is more reliable.
status: FIXED - Correctly migrated to ID-based lookup which is more resilient
failure_scenario: OLD: Two employees with same name would collide. NEW: ID-based lookup eliminates this collision risk. No failure.

summary: OVERTIME status determination moved from simple time comparison to comprehensive shift metrics
invariant: Must correctly identify when an employee has worked beyond their scheduled shift end time. Old code only checked if clock-out time > closing time, didn't account for otThresholdMinutes.
status: FIXED - New code applies 30-minute threshold via computeShiftTrackingMetrics()
failure_scenario: OLD: Employee clocking out 5 minutes late would be marked OVERTIME. NEW: Only marked OVERTIME if > 30 minutes past shift end (otThresholdMinutes). This is STRICTER and more reasonable.

summary: Location null-check removed from distance calculation conditional
invariant: Must not attempt to access location.lat and location.lng when location is null/undefined.
status: SAFE - Early guard added at line 554-559 ensures location is not null before this point
failure_scenario: If code at line 554-559 is removed or bypasssed, accessing location.lat/lng at line 565-566 would throw TypeError. Currently protected by early return.

summary: Template file deleted without proper replacement
new_code: [FILE MISSING - component.ts references templateUrl: './admin-corrections.component.html' at line 8]
invariant: Angular component must have a template file to render. Referencing non-existent template causes runtime error.
status: BROKEN - Component declared with template reference but HTML file does not exist
failure_scenario: AdminCorrectionsComponent will fail at runtime with 'Template file not found' error. The correction requests UI is non-functional.

summary: Grace time calculation changed from officeHours to workingWindow
invariant: Must use the correct grace period for lateness detection. Must respect employee's assigned shift grace period, not just global office hours.
status: IMPROVED - Now respects shift-specific grace periods when shifts are assigned
failure_scenario: OLD: All employees used global grace period even if on custom shifts. NEW: Shift-assigned employees get their shift's grace period. More accurate.

summary: Status determination moved to dedicated applyTrackingMetrics() method called after location validation
old_code: inline status logic after each action; missing comprehensive checks for absent/late/early-departure/undertime
new_code: applyTrackingMetrics(record, workingWindow, today) called after all record updates; computes all metrics holistically
invariant: Must correctly classify attendance status (ABSENT/PRESENT/LATE/OVERTIME/UNDERTIME) based on comprehensive shift comparison.
status: FIXED - New method computes all metrics from shift-tracking.util which handles edge cases (midnight-crossing shifts, grace periods, thresholds)
failure_scenario: OLD: Logic scattered, didn't handle midnight-crossing shifts or multiple status conditions. NEW: Centralized, handles all cases.
